command:
set -euo pipefail
COMMIT=05128a41f6ca17c0124e4b928953ac937fda2699
REPO=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
OUT=$ROOT/.go_evidence/avatar_identity_source_inventory_hardened_20260912_1029.json

P=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin "$COMMIT"
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-id-inventory2.XXXXXX)
cleanup(){ git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$TMP/src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }

p=sys.argv[1];x=json.load(open(p));print('schema',x['schema']);print('visual_root_file_count',x['visual_root_file_count']);print('candidate_counts',{k:len(v) for k,v in x['region_candidates'].items()});print('evidence_named_candidates',len(x['evidence_named_candidates']));print('text_references',len(x['text_references']));print('missing_explicit_region_candidates',x['missing_explicit_region_candidates']);print('roi_geometry_credit',x['roi_geometry_credit']);print('identity_preservation_credit',x['identity_preservation_credit']);print('sha256',hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest())
for region in ('hair','nose','mouth','neck','eyes','head'):
 print('REGION',region,[r.get('path') for r in x['region_candidates'].get(region,[])[:12]])
PY
HB=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html"|awk '{print $1}')
PB=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
test "$H" = "$HB"; test "$P" = "$PB"
